about_the_game:
EMOTIONAL DAMAGE INCOMING! The most ridiculously epic Souls-like parody ever created meets outrageous humor in this absolutely insane action-RPG! You're no chosen one – just a blacksmith with questionable bean-eating habits who accidentally gained ancient dragon powers. Now, you're humanity's last hope, and it's time to show these evil corporations what REAL power smells like!

UNLEASH THE POWER OF MAXIMUM GASITUDE!

🔥 Master the revolutionary "Gas-Souls" combat system – FART-DASH YOUR WAY TO VICTORY!

💥 Demolish epic bosses with over-the-top attacks and absurd finishers!

🌮 Feast on magical bean burritos for power-ups (now with 100% more dramatic zoom-ins!)

🕺 Strike fabulous poses while delivering devastating attacks!

💀 BECOME THE LEGEND that everyone talks about (but nobody wants to stand near).

FEATURING:

⚔️ Intense battles with tech billionaires and absurd villains!

🎭 A protagonist who won’t stop breaking the fourth wall!

💨 Weapons-grade dad jokes and ridiculous RPG mechanics!

🌟 Multiple endings based on your playstyle and gas-meter management!

READY TO BECOME THE HERO NOBODY ASKED FOR BUT EVERYONE CAN SMELL?

⚠️ Disclaimer: This game does not condone or promote negative stereotypes based on race, ethnicity, or nationality. Dark Farts: Parody Smell Edition is created purely for fun and humor—because we listen, we play, and we don’t judge.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains stylized fantasy combat and comedic action violence. Players fight enemies using melee weapons and exaggerated “gas-based” abilities in a cartoon, non-realistic manner. There is no graphic gore or realistic depictions of injury.

The game includes mild crude humor and toilet-themed jokes (e.g., fart-based abilities and bean-related powers), as well as light comedic language.

Some characters and story elements parody fictional tech leaders and authoritarian figures for satirical purposes, but the game does not depict real-world political events or promote harmful or discriminatory themes.

There is no sexual content, sexual assault, drug use, self-harm, or realistic depictions of abuse.

Overall tone is comedic, exaggerated, and fantasy-focused rather than realistic.
